description: Fork of exp202 (LN before LUT, descending well @ 1.94 by step 2200). Revert LUT shape to exp200's settings: nap 8 -> 6 (256 -> 64 cells/table), tph 1024 -> 4096 (more tables for higher pair coverage), smooth_mode True -> False (hard forward + STE). Hypothesis: the LN stabilization unlocks the higher-coverage hard-LUT config that was working but plateauing in exp200. Per-block LUT params unchanged (8.39M, math equivalent). Pair coverage 33.4% (vs 11.1% in exp201/202).
